input_selection.reader: collect([input_attempt]); only valid completion/result and inference/telemetry records

executed_command: python3 - <<'PY' (inline CPU check importing collect, summarize and using tempfile.TemporaryDirectory; no benchmark, rollout, GPU or video command)
temporary_output_note: The prior check generated the new CSV tables in TemporaryDirectory, checked them, and automatically removed that directory. This receipt records its already observed stdout and assertions; it does not claim persistent CSV artifacts or repeat the check.
passed_assertions: Exactly 80 selected valid episodes: E3 init6 first40 and its E1-D2 tau0.1 P2 parent init6 first40.
Every saved signed_error examined had shape (2,5,6).
Aggregate future_index coverage was exactly {1,2,3,4,5}; verify_branch coverage exactly {1,2}.
Every phase/step/branch group had 1..40 independent contributing episodes.
Summed saved boolean-check denominators matched the direct inference-journal counts: verify_gripper=2016 and post_verify_gripper=2016.
For every episode-equal group, the number of matching per-episode rows equaled independent_episodes.
For every episode-equal group, axis0_mean_signed, translation_rms, rotation_rms and distance_mean equaled the arithmetic mean of corresponding per-episode metrics (numpy.isclose atol=1e-12).

interpretation.error_units: model normalized coordinates, not mm or real EEF error
interpretation.episode_equal_definition: mean of within-episode signed means, RMS and distance means; episodes without observations in that group are not zero-filled
interpretation.gripper_definition: saved request-level boolean checks; counts above are denominators, not positive-event counts or per-step gripper disagreement
